title: EncoderOutputRelayCapabilities
description: Non-secret service capability hints. output_relay_mode describes Encoder/Recorder routing behavior only and never carries an RTMPS URL, relay URL, or YouTube stream key. scene_frames_mjpeg_srt and worker_frame_ingest_mjpeg_srt negotiate Worker-rendered JPEG images that are paced and encoded only by Encoder/Recorder. discord_resolved_target_v2 advertises actual Discord Bot support for the strict resolved-target start DTO; absence or any value other than boolean true must retain the legacy flat start DTO. New Encoder reports use the canonical direct, legacy_stream_key, or live_api_static relay values. The historical static value is accepted on Control Panel capability input and registered-service reads for migration compatibility, with legacy_stream_key semantics. Unknown relay-mode values must be rejected fail closed.

output_relay_mode.description: direct has no fixed output relay. legacy_stream_key is a fixed relay with a preconfigured legacy YouTube stream-key route. live_api_static is a fixed relay that accepts the non-secret live API static binding below. static is the historical alias for legacy_stream_key; it is accepted only for Control Panel input and registered-service read compatibility, while new Encoder reports must use a canonical value.

output_relay_binding_id.description: Required with live_api_static. Non-secret fixed relay binding identity that must match the selected live_api_relay_static output. It is never an RTMPS address or stream key.

scene_frames_mjpeg_srt.description: Worker can render the complete scene as a low-rate MJPEG image stream over the negotiated job-scoped SRT ingest without video encoding.

worker_frame_ingest_mjpeg_srt.description: Encoder/Recorder can receive Worker-rendered JPEG images, hold the latest frame, and perform the only video encode and audio mux.

live_encoder_runtime_settings.description: Encoder/Recorder can change the active stream audio gain and watermark image without restarting FFmpeg or its outputs.

scene_appearance_v1.description: Worker implements the complete scene appearance start snapshot, authenticated asset retrieval, integrity verification, cache, background render, header render, and exact default parity.

live_video_cover_v1.description: Encoder/Recorder implements generation-fenced Video Cover apply and reconcile with independent Cover and Watermark imagefeeds and graph-applied witnesses.

discord_resolved_target_v2.description: The Discord Bot actually accepts the strict schema_version=2 start DTO with one server-resolved discord_target snapshot. Control Panel may select that DTO only when the assigned Bot currently advertises this exact boolean true; absence, false, unknown values, and version strings are not support evidence and require the legacy flat payload without v2-only fields.

scene_video_srt.description: Legacy Worker H.264 MPEG-TS capability accepted only for migration reads. It is not negotiated by the current Control Panel.

worker_video_ingest_srt.description: Legacy Encoder H.264 MPEG-TS capability accepted only for migration reads. It is not negotiated by the current Control Panel.
